about.projectHint: Report bugs, follow development, or contribute.
about.versionHint: Free and open-source application dock for Omarchy · MIT license
about.wallHint: Everyone who has supported omadock, honored in the repository.
groups.empty: No groups yet. Drag one dock icon onto another, or create one from the apps that are running now.
menu.sort.name: Name
notify.missingAdvice: Reinstall the app or unpin it from the dock.
notify.missingLaunch: It cannot be launched — reinstall the app or unpin it from the dock.
notify.missingPin: It cannot be pinned to the dock — reinstall the app first.
notify.unsafeRemovalBody: %1 was removed while still mounted. Recent changes may not have been written; eject it from the dock next time.
panel.title: Dock settings
presets.full: 6 of 6 — delete one to save a new look
setting.alignment.hintSpread: Folders and drives go to the right edge.
setting.alignment.hintSpreadCentred: Both sides needs Split sections (Appearance); centred until then.
setting.alignment.hintTaskbar: Start at the left edge, app icons centred and the clock on the right.
setting.alignment.hintTaskbarNeedsPanel: Taskbar needs the Panel layout; centred until then.
setting.alignment.label: Alignment
setting.animations.hint: Reduced keeps short fades and drops movement and bounces. Off changes everything at once.
setting.animations.label: Animations
setting.appsButton.hint: The launcher at the start of the dock. Without it, right-click the dock background to reach these settings.
setting.appsButton.label: Omarchy button
setting.appsButtonAction.hint: The app grid searches every app and lets you drag one onto the dock to pin it.
setting.appsButtonAction.label: Omarchy button opens
setting.autohide.hint: Intelligent hides only when a window overlaps the dock.
setting.autohide.label: Autohide
setting.badgeColor.hint: Accent, urgent red, or a neutral pill.
setting.badgeColor.label: Badge color
setting.badgePosition.hint: The corner of the icon the badge sits on.
setting.badgePosition.label: Badge position
setting.badgeStyle.hint: A count pill or a plain dot on the icon.
setting.badgeStyle.label: Badge style
setting.badges.hint: Count active notification popups on pinned apps; clears on dismissal or expiry.
setting.badges.label: Notification badges
setting.bgColor.hint: Theme, none, or a fixed preset.
setting.bgColor.label: Color
setting.bgFill.hint: A solid colour, or colours melting into each other like Zen / Arc themes.
setting.bgFill.label: Fill
setting.blur.hintOff: Hyprland blur is off (decoration:blur:enabled), so this has no visible effect.
setting.blur.label: Blur
setting.blurSize.hint: Hyprland has one blur size for everything, so this also changes it for windows and other panels. Back to your own value when blur leaves this mode.
setting.blurSize.label: Blur strength
setting.blurSystem.hint: Leave blur behind the dock to your Hyprland layer rules.
setting.blurSystem.label: Blur from system
setting.border.label: Border
setting.borderOpacity.label: Border opacity
setting.borderOpacityTheme.hint: Derive the rim opacity from the dock's opacity, as themes expect. Turn off to set it by hand.
setting.borderOpacityTheme.label: Border opacity from theme
setting.borderWidth.label: Border width
setting.cornerRadius.label: Corner radius
setting.corners.label: Corners
setting.customFolder.hint: Pick any directory to pin as a stack.
setting.customFolder.label: Custom folder
setting.dividerHeight.hint: Length of the lines between sections, as a share of the dock's height.
setting.dividerHeight.label: Divider height
setting.dividerLength.hint: Classic preserves the original icon-height lines. Long uses an adjustable share of the dock height.
setting.dividerLength.label: Divider length style
setting.dividerOpacity.label: Divider opacity
setting.dividerStyle.hint: Theme draws the lines like the border, in its colour, opacity and width. Custom sets the width and opacity by hand. Hidden drops the lines and the room around them, for docks whose plates already show the sections.
setting.dividerStyle.label: Divider style
setting.dividerWidth.label: Divider width
setting.floatingDock.hint: Omarchy shows its own dock on floating workspaces. Hiding it runs omarchy plugin disable omarchy.dock; after removing omadock, bring it back with omarchy plugin enable omarchy.dock.
setting.floatingDock.label: Floating workspaces
setting.gradientPalette.hint: Theme builds one from the Omarchy theme's accent and palette.
setting.gradientPalette.label: Palette
setting.gradientStrength.hint: How strongly the colours show over the theme background.
setting.gradientStrength.label: Strength
setting.grain.hint: Film grain over the background. Works on solid, translucent and blurred backgrounds alike.
setting.grain.label: Grain
setting.groupIconEffects.hint: Theme applies the style from the Icons page to the icons of an opened group.
setting.groupIconEffects.label: Icon style
setting.groupStyle.hint: Frame drawn around a group's icons in the dock.
setting.groupStyle.label: Tile style
setting.hoverEffect.label: Hover effect
setting.iconContrast.hint: Separates the symbol from its backdrop; high values flatten icons to a simple, poster-like shape.
setting.iconContrast.label: Contrast
setting.iconHoverOriginal.hint: The icon under the pointer drops the style and shows as shipped. Icons in an opened group follow this too.
setting.iconHoverOriginal.label: Show original on hover
setting.iconHoverReveal.hint: The original icon appears cell by cell, rising from the bottom, instead of all at once.
setting.iconHoverReveal.label: Dithered reveal
setting.iconSize.label: Icon size
setting.iconStrength.hint: How much of the effect covers the original icon.
setting.iconStrength.label: Strength
setting.iconStyle.hint: Monochrome and dot matrix take one colour from the theme.
setting.iconStyle.label: Icon style
setting.iconTint.label: Icon colour
setting.indicators.hint: The dots and bars under icons. Theme follows the corners above.
setting.indicators.label: Indicators
setting.itemSpacing.hintPlates: Gap between icons. Label plates keep it between 4 and 12 px.
setting.itemSpacing.label: Spacing
setting.keepPointer.hint: Don't move the mouse pointer onto the window a click brings up.
setting.keepPointer.label: Keep pointer in place
setting.labelBackground.hint: Plate puts icon and name on one surface, like a button.
setting.labelBackground.label: Background
setting.labelColor.hint: Auto picks black or white for what is behind the icons; Theme uses the bar's text colour.
setting.labelColor.label: Color
setting.labelEffect.label: Effect
setting.labelFont.label: Font
setting.labelIndicators.hint: Window marks as a column at the plate's edge, so every plate lines up.
setting.labelIndicators.label: Indicators
setting.labelKind.label: Show on
setting.labelMaxWidth.hint: Longer names drop subtitles, then trailing words, then end in an ellipsis.
setting.labelMaxWidth.label: Max width
setting.labelMode.hint: Names beside the icons: always, or slid out while the pointer rests on an icon.
setting.labelMode.label: Labels
setting.labelPinned.hint: When running shows a pinned app's name only while it has a window; a closed one keeps just its icon.
setting.labelPinned.label: Pinned apps
setting.labelPlateHeight.hint: Dock stretches plates to the dock's top and bottom, the same gap away as from each other.
setting.labelPlateHeight.label: Plate height
setting.labelReveal.hint: How a name appears when the pointer rests on an icon.
setting.labelReveal.label: Reveal
setting.labelShape.hint: Dock follows the dock's own corners. Square meets between plates and rounds the outer ones along the dock's edge; Pill gives every plate round ends.
setting.labelShape.label: Corners
setting.labelSize.label: Size
setting.labelWeight.label: Weight
setting.launchBounce.hint: Bounce the icon while an app is starting.
setting.launchBounce.label: Launch bounce
setting.layout.hint: Panel spans the screen's full width along the bottom edge.
setting.layout.label: Layout
setting.minimizeMode.hint: Clicking the focused app's icon parks its windows.
setting.minimizeMode.label: Minimize on click
setting.minimizedTiles.hint: Show parked windows as preview tiles in the dock.
setting.minimizedTiles.label: Minimized window tiles
setting.monitorSelect.hintSingle: Automatic picks the first connected output.
setting.multiMonitor.label: Show on all monitors
setting.opacity.label: Opacity
setting.opacityTheme.hint: Follow the bar opacity of the current Omarchy theme.
setting.opacityTheme.label: Opacity from theme
setting.panelSpacing.hint: Gap between the panels when sections are split.
setting.panelSpacing.label: Panel spacing
setting.perMonitorApps.hint: Each dock lists the windows on its own monitor; pinned apps show everywhere.
setting.perMonitorApps.label: Only this monitor's apps
setting.removableDrives.hint: Show mounted USB drives at the end of the dock.
setting.removableDrives.label: Removable drives
setting.restoreSlot.hint: Put the window back in the place it held in the tiling layout, not at the end. Only when the layout has not changed in the meantime.
setting.restoreSlot.label: Restore original slot
setting.restoreWorkspace.hint: Where a minimized window comes back to. Windows restores it to the workspace it was minimized from.
setting.restoreWorkspace.label: Restore on
setting.revealDelay.hint: How long the pointer rests on the edge before the dock slides in.
setting.revealDelay.label: Reveal delay
setting.shadowStrength.label: Strength
setting.showBackground.hint: Fill behind the icons. Off leaves the icons floating.
setting.showBackground.label: Background
setting.showShadow.hint: Under the dock; with the background off, under each icon.
setting.showShadow.label: Shadow
setting.splitSections.hint: Each part between the dividers becomes its own panel, with a gap in place of the divider.
setting.splitSections.label: Split sections
setting.tooltipDelay.label: Tooltip delay
setting.tooltips.label: Tooltips
setting.updateChannel.hint: Stable receives verified releases; Experimental gets features early. Switching reloads the shell immediately.
setting.updateChannel.label: Update channel
setting.urgentHint.hint: Mark apps whose windows ask for attention.
setting.urgentHint.label: Urgent highlights
setting.urgentOnNotification.hint: A notification from an app marks its icon.
setting.urgentOnNotification.label: Urgent on notification
setting.urgentSound.label: Urgent sound
setting.warnUnsafeRemoval.hint: Notify when a drive is pulled out while still mounted.
setting.warnUnsafeRemoval.label: Warn on unsafe removal
setting.wheelStepDelay.hint: Scrolling over an app flips through its windows; this paces the steps.
setting.wheelStepDelay.label: Wheel step delay
setting.windowPreviews.hint: Thumbnails of an app's windows in its tooltip; scroll over the icon to flip through them.
setting.windowPreviews.label: Window previews
